test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution has the idea that 'No child below the age of fourteen years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 24**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 24 of the Indian Constitution **addresses the prohibition of child labour, aimed at **safeguarding the well-being and rights of children**.
 
• Its primary objective is to prevent the exploitation of children by prohibiting their employment in hazardous occupations or processes.
 
• According to Article 24, no child below the age of fourteen years can be employed in factories, mines, or any other hazardous employment. This measure is implemented to ensure the protection of children's health, development, and access to education.
 
• While Article 24 establishes a general prohibition, it also allows for certain exceptions. These exceptions include situations where children engage in non-hazardous work within their family, participate in work as part of their school curriculum, or undertake harmless or innocent occupations.
 
• Additionally, Article 24 grants the government the authority to enact legislation specifying the occupations and processes deemed hazardous for children. This provision enables the government to establish necessary regulations and restrictions to effectively enforce the prohibition of child labour. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 22 of the Indian Constitution** addresses the protection against arrest and detention in specific circumstances. This provision applies to both citizens and non-citizens and aims to provide procedural safeguards during arrests. The fundamental principle underlying this right is to prevent arbitrary arrests and detention, ensuring that individuals are afforded due process of law.
 
• In contrast, **Article 19** safeguards six fundamental rights related to freedom, including speech and expression, assembly, association, movement, residence, and profession.
 
• On the other hand,** Article 20** focuses on protecting citizens concerning convictions for offenses. It offers three types of protection against the State, ensuring fairness and justice in legal proceedings.
